blocks.text: Following Michael's list this morning, I have tried to make the first item quicker for you to answer.

The highlighted proof points are now on a single page, in the order they appear in the framework. Each one has a keep or drop column beside it, with room for a replacement figure. The page is in the shared {{fact:f:E-2023-001.client}} folder, next to the framework.

On the third item, Amy and I can make any slot in the last week of the month. Amy will bring her first draft of the investor questions and answers. That way we can test the answers against the same confirmed figures in the same session.
As soon as you pick a time, I will send a calendar hold to everyone on this thread.
